item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kazem Bitaghsir Fadafan, Wei Cui, Babak Haghighat, Shailesh Lal
arXiv:2606.15799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a machine learning framework for extracting Ising topological order from defect partition functions of the two-dimensional Ising model on a torus. Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) are trained on Ising model data sampled at criticality across topological sectors. We take a component-wise square-root map of the learned distributions which naturally produces candidate wavefunctions for the (2+1)-dimensional Ising TQFT. As a nontrivial consistency check, we extract the modular S-matrix from overlaps of the resulting states and recover the expected Ising modular data. item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Sara Shahbazi Fashtali, Pablo M. Piaggi, Giuseppe Zollo
The mechanical response of graphene oxide (GO) is controlled by oxidation level and functional group composition, yet a clear atomic level picture remains ambiguous due to limitations of classical reactive force fields. Here, we develop a machine learning interatomic potential by fine-tuning a MACE foundation model on DFT data. We employ this potential to systematically investigate GO tensile behavior across oxidation levels of 10–40 % and hydroxyl-to-epoxy (OH/O) ratios of 0–3. Our potential accurately reproduces the expected decrease in Young's modulus and ultimate tensile strength with increasing oxidation, correcting the overestimation and dispersion characteristic of ReaxFF predictions. item.title: 基于部分观测的稀疏 Mori-哈密顿量的正实辨识
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mohammad A. Ayoubi
本文针对部分状态不可观测的保守哈密顿系统提出一种新的辨识方法，无需先重建隐藏状态。作者证明，将动力学投影到可测坐标后得到的记忆核是一个无损的正实有理矩阵，其极点对应隐藏自然频率，半正定留数编码耦合关系。该方法可仅由输出数据识别出被动、可解释且具外推能力的闭合方程，并在多种线性、非线性与混沌系统上得到验证。

The strategy is built from four physics-motivated designs: a stride-matched local-rule convolution, geometric pooling, a sign-resolving tanh(x²k⁺¹) activation, and explicit spin-hole sector separation. arXiv:2510.06137v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Moiré materials offer a versatile platform for engineering excitons with unprecedented control, promising next-generation optoelectronic applications. While continuum models are widely used to study moiré excitons due to their computational efficiency, they often disagree with ab initio many-body approaches, as seen for intralayer excitons in WS₂/WSe₂ heterobilayers. arXiv:2606.16557v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quadrupolar excitons in van der Waals heterostructures - quantum superpositions of anti-aligned dipolar excitons - offer a novel platform to explore exotic many-body physics, with applications to quantum sensing and photonic devices. item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hao-Cheng Thong, Bo Wu, Fan Hu, Pedro B. Groszewicz, Chen-Bo-Wen Li, Jun Chen, Mao-Hua Zhang, Dragan Damjanovic, Ben Xu, Ke Wang
arXiv:2510.25142v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report the discovery of a geometric pathway for tuning ferroelectric properties through thermally driven reconfiguration between coexisting polar states in Li-substituted NaNbO3. Using first-principles density functional theory calculation and 7Li solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy measurement, we reveal that Li substitution creates two distinct polar configurations whose transformation under annealing enhances the Curie temperature and induces piezoelectric hardening. Our findings establish a geometrically-driven polar state reconfiguration mechanism, providing a general design principle for ferroics whereby macroscopic functional properties can be engineered via lattice geometry.
